mapper.select: select widm.* FROM wms_inbound_detail_manufactured widm LEFT JOIN wms_inbound_manufactured wim ON wim.id = widm.inbound_manufactured_id where widm.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wim.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wim.review_status = 2 and widm.apply_purchase_id = #{id} order by widm.basic_class, widm.thickness

select IFNULL(sum(widm.quantity),0) as quantity from wms_inbound_detail_manufactured widm left join wms_inbound_manufactured wim on widm.inbound_manufactured_id = wim.id and wim.bool_delete_enum = 0 where widm.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wim.review_status = 2 and widm.purchase_order_detail_id = #{purchaseDetailId}

select widm.* FROM wms_inbound_detail_manufactured widm LEFT JOIN wms_inbound_manufactured wim ON wim.id = widm.inbound_manufactured_id where widm.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wim.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wim.review_status = 2 and widm.purchase_order_detail_id in
#{purchaseDetailId}

select wim.purchase_id as id, IFNULL(sum(widm.total_weight),0) as mete from wms_inbound_detail_manufactured widm left join wms_inbound_manufactured wim on widm.inbound_manufactured_id = wim.id where widm.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wim.review_status = 2
and wim.purchase_id in
#{purchaseId}
group by wim.purchase_id
